release_policy.rollback_action: pin the previous registry version and reject new jobs using the failed Skill version

compatibility_dimensions: Python and deterministic tool dependency version

skills.call_condition: once at intake before any audit or planning
skills.evaluation_gate: all versioned Profiles load or fail closed; runtime text cannot mutate a Profile

skills.call_condition: initial audit and every independent final verification
skills.evaluation_gate: all required GLB structure, bounds and reference checks complete or fail closed

skills.call_condition: when the active Profile enables implemented geometry checks
skills.evaluation_gate: implemented triangle, accessor, non-finite and degenerate checks pass Golden tests
skills.claim_boundary: candidate non-core geometry extension until the missing checks have independent Golden tests

skills.call_condition: only when the initial AuditReport contains ERROR findings
skills.evaluation_gate: every READY plan is hash-bound, Profile-bound and whitelist-only; unsupported findings become MANUAL_ONLY

skills.call_condition: L1 degenerate-triangle plan with a verified checkpoint
skills.evaluation_gate: at least five independent repair attempts, success rate >= 90%, original hash unchanged

skills.call_condition: L2 oversized embedded texture plan with human approval bound to plan_id and asset_sha256
skills.evaluation_gate: approved resize preserves aspect ratio, passes full regression and never mutates original

skills.call_condition: every candidate or clean final gate before publish
skills.evaluation_gate: all target findings resolved, zero new ERROR, required checks complete, rollback suite 100%
